title: Project Head For Greenfield Grinding project at Uluberia W.B.
description:
Role & responsibilities Project Planning & Execution Lead the overall planning, design, engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning of the cement plant. Develop project execution strategies, schedules, budgets, and resource plans. Monitor project progress and take corrective actions to ensure timely completion. Coordinate with consultants, contractors, equipment suppliers, and internal stakeholders. . Engineering & Technology Management Finalize plant capacity, process design, equipment specifications, and technology selection. Review engineering drawings, layouts, and technical proposals. Ensure adoption of best-in-class technologies for efficiency, sustainability, and operational excellence. . Procurement & Contract Management Oversee tendering, bid evaluation, vendor selection, and contract finalization. Manage EPC/EPCM contractors and equipment suppliers. Monitor procurement timelines and logistics to avoid project delays. Construction Management Direct civil, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and infrastructure activities. Ensure adherence to construction quality standards and technical specifications. Resolve critical project issues and resource constraints. Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) Promote a strong safety culture across the project. Ensure compliance with HSE standards, environmental regulations, and company policies. Monitor safety performance and implement preventive measures. Cost & Budget Control Manage project budgets and cash flow requirements. Track project expenditures and ensure optimum utilization of resources. Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality and safety. Commissioning & Plant Stabilization Lead commissioning and performance guarantee tests. Coordinate trial runs and plant stabilization activities. Ensure achievement of design capacity, quality, and energy consumption parameters. . Stakeholder Management Build strong relationships with local communities, government agencies, investors, consultants, and contractors. Present periodic project status reports to senior management and Board members. Manage community and CSR-related concerns during project execution.  Team Leadership Build and lead multidisciplinary project teams. Mentor project managers, engineers, and site personnel. Drive performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Key Skills: Execution,Project Management,Erection,Commissioning,Project Planning,Project,Compensation,Grinding
